title: Skill catalog
goal: Find a skill in the global catalog and open its card for the current discipline.
primaryQuestion: Does this skill exist, and does it have a card in my discipline?
_why: The screen that shows the skill / card split with the eyes: the catalog is GLOBAL (a skill exists once), while having a card is per discipline. A skill without a card in the chosen discipline stays in the list, muted and labelled, instead of disappearing — disappearing would look like the skill itself is per-discipline, which is exactly the old model's mistake.

zones.name: header
zones.purpose: The same global discipline switch (SegmentedControl) in the page actions; switching it re-labels which skills have a card here without changing the catalog itself.

zones.name: toolbar
zones.purpose: SearchInput narrows by skill name; one FilterDropdown narrows to the skills that have a card in the current discipline.

zones.name: catalog
zones.answers: Does this skill exist, and does it have a card in my discipline?
zones.purpose: Skill tiles grouped under their group headings (SectionLabel), the groups of the current discipline first, skills with no card here under their own heading last. Each tile: the global skill name as the link, its one-line description, a MetaItem per discipline that has a card for it, and — when the current discipline has none — a quiet tile with a Badge saying 'No card in .NET' (or Java). Same tile language as the profiles screen.

states.empty: EmptyState via the template's empty prop, reason no-matches, icon=search: the search or filter matched nothing; the action clears both.
states.error: Static seed data cannot fail to load; the only empty the reader can cause is the no-matches EmptyState above.

data: skills: global name, description, group per discipline (via the card), which disciplines have a card

behaviours.given: a global skill with no card in the chosen discipline
behaviours.then: the skill stays visible under its own final heading and says its state — it never disappears and never errors
behaviours.why: Invariant 3 of the data model: skill is global, the card is per (skill, discipline).
